title: Hacienda Lealtad
representedDate: Restored visitor estate, approximate current architecture
geometryBasis: The standing Lares hacienda visitor precinct at the municipality’s published location, with the timber casa grande, coffee-processing balcony range, courtyard-side dependencies and the glácil drying terrace.
sectionBasis: The municipality’s directions, USGS roof imagery and measured OpenStreetMap ways establish the hillside placement. The municipality’s building description supplies the timber-over-brick construction, zinc gable, coffee machinery balcony and the masonry dry court. Original terrain fixes grade.
limitations: The main visitor buildings use the municipality’s published site, about 2.3 km from the Qualla article’s locality marker. The individual building functions and the drying terrace’s exact orientation are inferred from the mapped roofs, farm documentation and slope.

The USDA Qualla view shows an interior. Exterior siding color, window placements, rails, wheel detail and final elevations are reasonable estimates supported by the timber construction and masonry descriptions.
